description: This stacked horizontal bar chart, titled “QA-2,” displays performance metrics for two models—“EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0” and “RedWhale (our)” — across three categories: “Correct,” “Partially Correct,” and “Incorrect,” as indicated by a legend with dark purple, medium blue, and light blue respectively. The vertical axis lists the model names, while the horizontal axis represents the performance values, which are shown as percentages within each colored segment of the bars, with no explicit axis label or scale shown. The top bar for “EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0” is composed of a dark purple segment labeled “92.9,” a medium blue segment labeled “2.9,” and a light blue segment labeled “4.3.” The bottom bar for “RedWhale (our)” is composed of a dark purple segment labeled “95.7,” a medium blue segment labeled “1.4,” and a light blue segment labeled “2.9.” The bars are not sorted and are presented in a fixed vertical order, with “RedWhale (our)” positioned below “EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0.” No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, or outlining beyond their color-coding according to the legend.
